m: माथाथ n. N. of two Sāmans, ĀrṣBr.

s: i kunTe । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvA॰-para॰saka॰-sew .) i, mAnTyate । kunTo vaDakleSO । iti durgAdAsaH ॥
puM, (mAnTyate pIqyate janaH asmin । mATa + GaY । jvalAditvAt Ro vA । nipAtanAt numaBAvaH .) panTAH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (maTa + BAve GaY .) manTanam । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: baDe saka॰ kleSe aka॰ BvA॰ pa॰ sew idit । mAnyati amAnvIt
pu॰ maTa--GaY । 1 paTi trikA॰ । 2 manTane Sabdara॰ ।
m: माथ m. (√ मथ्) churning, stirring, W.
a: माथः — [मथ्-घञ्] 1 Stirring, churning, shaking about. --2 Killing, destruction. --3 A way, road.

m: माथितिक mfn. dealing in buttermilk (मथित), Pāṇ. v, 3, 83, Vārtt. 2, Pat.
माथुरी f. N. of various works.

s: puM, (maTurA + aR .) maTurAyA AgataH । iti mugDaboDavyAkaraRam ॥ (tatra jAta ityaR vA । maTurAjAtaH । yaTA, kaTAsaritsAgare । 36 । 73 । “tataH sa dfzwabahulakleSastAM puruzo'bravIt । mugDe ! pavanasenAKyo baRikputtro'smi mATuraH ॥” anyena kftA mATureRa proktA । “tena proktam .” 4 । 3 । 104 । iti aR NIp । mATurIvfttiH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥)
v: tri॰ maTurAyAM Bavo maTurAyAH Agato vA aR । 1 maTurAnagarIBave, 2 tata Agate ca ।
m: माथुर mf(ई)n. coming from or born in or belonging to Mathurā, Hariv.; Kathās.
relating or belonging to Mathurā, Cat.
माथुर m. an inhabitant of Mathurā, Hariv.
N. of a son of Citra-gupta, Cat.
of the keeper of a gambling house, Mṛcch.
a: माथुर — a. (री f.) [मथुरायां भवो मथुराया आगतो वा अण्] 1 Coming from Mathurā. --2 Produced in Mathurā. --3 Dwelling in Mathurā.

m: माथुर—देश्य mfn. coming from the Mathurā district, MBh.
माथुरक m. pl. the inhabitants of Mathurā, Cat.
